d:
"deva ho deva ganapti deva tumse barhkar kaun" bhakti aur shraddha se ot-prot ek sundar ganesh bhajan hai, jise aasha bhosle ji ne apni madhur aavaz men gaya hai. yah bhajan ganesh chaturthi aur any shubh avasron par ghar-ghar men gunjta hai aur bhakton ke hriday men bappa ke prati prem aur aastha ko aur gahra kar deta hai.
Eeshvar ke aise anek madhur pyare bhajan, mantr aartiyan sunne ke lie sabsakraib karen :
Kharidie karvan mobail- 1500 prilodid ganon vala kipaid fon dhamakedar saund ke sath
Credits:-
Song Name: Ganpati 2022 Special: Ganpati Bappa Moriya(Deva Ho Deva)
